t.why: A relatively stable country in the Sahel, where offshore gas development has begun.
t.rel: A country linking North Africa and sub-Saharan Africa that stays neutral in the Western Sahara dispute. It has taken in many people fleeing Mali's civil war.
t.know: One of the world's longest freight trains crosses the desert carrying iron ore.
t.etext: Iron ore, gold and fish are the main exports. Offshore gas development has made it a gas exporter.
